transcriber_notes: Source is a JPG export of an Avanet page (1520x1860 px, header partly cropped, no logo); measured on the source image (7.28 px/cm). Boundaries printed on the right axis (130, 120, 107, 78, 77, 53, 52, 17, 0) and confirmed by bar steps (thin 78-77 and 53-52 layers drawn taller in the table). Hardness from bar left edges vs the I/K/P/1F/4F/F grid (379.5/498.5/618.5/738.5/858.5/978.5 px); every bar ends on a class line. Temperature is a red line without point markers that stops at 60 cm: break points 120, 110, 100, 90, 80 cm plus ends 130 (surface) and 60 cm; 0 C at x=1028 px, 21.47 px/C (the Avanet template scale transferred via the hardness grid); the dashed air-temperature segment starts at -1.0 C = printed air temp; vertices land on 0.5 C steps (+-0.2 C at this resolution). Rounded-bottom V glyphs recorded as SHxr (class SH if the subclass is disputed).
